ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The ventral surface displays a ratio of approximately 35% high-intensity (white) pixels to 65% low-intensity (black) pixels, with high-intensity regions concentrated at the lateral distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous blobs are localized at the outer margins of both lobes. On the left lobe, the patch extends from the tip inward to roughly 40% of the lobe width. On the right lobe, the white patch is smaller, occupying approximately 20% of the distal area with high-frequency black mottling along its interior border.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture angle of approximately 68 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of 1:8 relative to the fluke's maximum width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency serration pattern with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 12 pixels; characterized by irregular, jagged peaks and deep vertical notches along the entire continuous boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave curvature from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly upward-turned points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, circular, high-contrast beige/white pixel clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization. Minor circular white spots are visible on the distal peduncle surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine-line vertical and diagonal pixel disruptions are visible within the high-intensity white patches on the lateral surfaces, appearing as dark grey streaks against the white background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular notches and missing tissue fragments along the trailing edge topography; dense barnacle encrustations localized specifically at the terminal ends of the lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced longitudinal ridge (keel) extending from the peduncle into the median notch area, creating a distinct 3D shadow profile against the water background.
